name: Quality Manager Agent
description: H2A2H enterprise employee agent implementing the Quality Manager role. The A2A Agent Card provides discovery identity; H2A2H adds delegation, Human responsibility, policy, provenance and Proof-of-Human-Return.

skills.name: Analyze as Quality Manager
skills.description: Analyze information relevant to the Quality Manager role and produce evidence-backed findings.

skills.name: Execute Quality Manager work
skills.description: Execute delegated Quality Manager work using only the declared tool allowlist and approval policy.

skills.name: Report Quality Manager outcome
skills.description: Return a structured Quality Manager result with provenance, audit references and Human-return status.
